section: Iterate — change: enforce the coverage minimum and declare the Node version
title: Enforce the 80% unit-test coverage minimum; declare Node >=22.12
context: vitest.config.ts nested its 80% thresholds under a Jest-style 'global' key, which vitest reads as a file glob, so the minimum never applied. Vitest 5 also requires Node 22.12, but nothing in the repo said so.
decision: Put the four thresholds directly under coverage.thresholds. Add .nvmrc (22) and engines.node >=22.12, and document both in the README.
consequences: npm test and CI now fail if global statements, branches, functions or lines coverage drops below 80%. The current tightest margin is branches at 87.66%. Netlify's fallback build also picks up Node 22 from .nvmrc.
rationale: The 80% minimum was always intended. Coverage already clears it, so enforcing it is safe.
rejected: Per-file thresholds: several small UI files are below 80%, and that would be a new policy rather than the intended one.
